params.prompt: Edit the FIRST image only, preserving its exact full camera composition, Astrid face, blonde hair, skin tone, black suit and sleeves to wrists, ivory blouse, body proportions, room, lighting, table text and existing shoe dimensions and location. Make one small source-bound change to the drawing hand and a single card: Astrid's right hand reaching across toward viewer-right presses the exposed leading edge of ONE red-backed face-down card, halfway extracted THROUGH THE LOW BLACK FRONT MOUTH of the existing shoe, lying low almost flat over the felt immediately outside that front lip toward viewer-left/down. Rear half of the card is naturally occluded inside the existing black mouth; exposed half has a red patterned back, no face/rank/pips. The inclined WHITE STACK STAYS FIXED. Do not lift a card above the stack. The second and third image crops show only the mechanical downward/outward front-lip extraction, not a new shoe or scene. In first-image 1920x1080 coordinates the visible low front lip is approximately1172,630 to1237,662; fingertips should press the exposed red leading edge around1190,646. These guide coordinates are approximate, respect anatomy and shoe occlusion. Only adjust drawing wrist/fingers and small forearm region as needed for a natural normal hand. Opposite resting hand stays visible unchanged. Preserve original sleeve length; no stretched arm, duplicated fingers, extra card, second shoe, bent/growing card, white raised panel, camera change or labels. This is one realistic halfway-through-extraction contact pose, not an upright presentation.
